error.message: Dependency restore is blocked by outbound proxy/network policy; Laravel cannot bootstrap without vendor/autoload.php.

verdict_note: Incident is not closed. Diagnose command must be re-run on an environment with prebuilt vendor/ or network access to dependency sources.

infra_actionable_ticket.title: Restore Laravel runtime bootstrap for diagnostics container
required_actions: Provide CI/build artifact that includes vendor/ matching composer.lock
OR run diagnose in Docker image where composer dependencies are preinstalled
OR allow proxy egress for repo.packagist.org, api.github.com, and getcomposer.org
OR configure corporate Composer mirror/Satis and point repositories to mirror
OR supply COMPOSER_AUTH/GitHub token if policy permits but rate/auth is the blocker
infra_actionable_ticket.done_definition: php artisan --version succeeds and php artisan poof:diagnose-courier-dispatch --date=2026-05-11 --courier-id=2 returns diagnostic JSON on real data
